```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
target_script <- "../_targets.R"
target_store <- "../_targets"
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This walkthrough shows how to run the OpenPVA targets pipeline, inspect
replicate outputs, plot mean trajectories, and run YAML scenarios under both
schema v1 (legacy-compatible) and schema v2 (explicit reproduction semantics).

## Set up environment

Ensure the `renv` environment has been initialised (via `Rscript bootstrap_env.R` or `renv::restore()`).

## Run the targets pipeline

```{r, eval=FALSE}
targets::tar_make(
  script = target_script,
  store = target_store,
  names = c(
    "sim_basic_reps_extinction_summary",
    "sim_basic_dense_harvest_extinction_summary",
    "sim_basic_dense_harvest_trajectory",
    "sim_basic_dense_harvest_trajectory_plot"
  )
)
```

## Inspect replicate outputs

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Extinction summary for the baseline replicate scenario
sim_basic_reps_extinction_summary <- targets::tar_read(sim_basic_reps_extinction_summary, store = target_store)
sim_basic_reps_extinction_summary
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Extinction summary for the density + harvest scenario
sim_basic_dense_harvest_extinction_summary <- targets::tar_read(sim_basic_dense_harvest_extinction_summary, store = target_store)
sim_basic_dense_harvest_extinction_summary
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Mean trajectory across replicates
sim_basic_dense_harvest_trajectory <- targets::tar_read(sim_basic_dense_harvest_trajectory, store = target_store)
head(sim_basic_dense_harvest_trajectory)
```

## Plot the mean trajectory

```{r, eval=FALSE}
plot_mean_trajectory(sim_basic_dense_harvest_trajectory)
```

## Run a schema v2 scenario from YAML

```{r, eval=FALSE}
path_v2 <- system.file("extdata", "demo_reproduction_v2.yaml", package = "OpenPVA")
if (path_v2 == "") path_v2 <- file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", "demo_reproduction_v2.yaml")
scenario_v2 <- read_scenario_yaml(path_v2)
attr(scenario_v2, "yaml_schema_version")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
yaml_result_v2 <- run_scenario(scenario_v2)
summarise_extinction(yaml_result_v2$sim_output)

head(yaml_result_v2$sim_output$summary[, c(
  "year", "n_births",
  "env_repro_p_mult", "env_repro_lambda_mult",
  "cat_repro_mult", "repro_catastrophe"
)])
```

## Genetics and inbreeding demo

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sc_gen <- OpenPVA::make_simple_genetic_scenario(
  name = "genetic_demo",
  n_runs = 10,
  n_years = 30,
  initial_n = 80,
  n_loci = 10,
  n_alleles = 2,
  mutation_rate = 0.001,
  beta_F = 0.5,
  K = 100
)
sc_gen$seed <- 20260401L

out_gen <- OpenPVA::run_scenario(sc_gen)

# Extinction summary for the genetics-enabled scenario
OpenPVA::summarise_extinction(out_gen$sim_output)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Diversity summary for the final population of the first run
final_pop_run1 <- out_gen$sim_output$runs[[1]]$population
OpenPVA::summarise_genetic_diversity(final_pop_run1, alive_only = TRUE)
```

## Spatial patches and dispersal

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sc_spatial <- OpenPVA::make_two_patch_spatial_scenario(
  name = "two_patch_demo",
  n_runs = 10,
  n_years = 30,
  initial_n = c(50L, 10L),
  K_patches = c(80, 40),
  dispersal_matrix = matrix(c(0.9, 0.1,
                               0.2, 0.8),
                             nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
)
sc_spatial$seed <- 20260402L

out_spatial <- OpenPVA::run_scenario(sc_spatial)

patch_summary <- OpenPVA::summarise_patch_occupancy_final(
  sim_output = out_spatial$sim_output,
  n_patches = 2,
  alive_only = TRUE
)
patch_summary
```

## Comparing harvest strategies

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sc_low_harvest <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "low_harvest",
  n_runs = 15,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(80),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 100,
  harvest_quota = 2,
  lifecycle_steps = OpenPVA::default_lifecycle_steps(),
  seed = 20260403L
)

sc_high_harvest <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "high_harvest",
  n_runs = 15,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(80),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 100,
  harvest_quota = 10,
  lifecycle_steps = OpenPVA::default_lifecycle_steps(),
  seed = 20260404L
)

harvest_scenarios <- list(
  low = sc_low_harvest,
  high = sc_high_harvest
)

harvest_comparison <- OpenPVA::compare_scenarios(
  harvest_scenarios,
  extinction_threshold = 0
)
harvest_comparison
```

## Custom age-structured survival from a table

```{r, eval=FALSE}
surv_table <- OpenPVA::make_default_survival_table()
surv_table$p_surv[surv_table$age_min >= 5] <- 0.5

surv_table <- OpenPVA::validate_survival_table(surv_table)
surv_fun_custom <- OpenPVA::build_survival_fun_from_table(surv_table)

sc_custom_surv <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "custom_survival_yaml_demo",
  n_runs = 15,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(80),
  survival_fun = surv_fun_custom,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 100,
  seed = 20260405L
)

out_custom <- OpenPVA::run_scenario(sc_custom_surv)
OpenPVA::summarise_extinction(out_custom$sim_output)
```

## Custom breeding and fecundity from tables

```{r, eval=FALSE}
breed_tbl <- OpenPVA::make_default_breeding_table()
breed_tbl$can_breed[breed_tbl$sex == "F" & breed_tbl$age_min >= 4] <- TRUE
breed_tbl$age_min[breed_tbl$sex == "F" & breed_tbl$age_min >= 4] <- 5

breed_tbl <- OpenPVA::validate_breeding_table(breed_tbl)
breeding_fun_custom <- OpenPVA::build_breeding_fun_from_table(breed_tbl)

fec_tbl <- data.frame(
  age_min = c(0, 5),
  age_max = c(4, Inf),
  sex = c("F", "F"),
  lambda = c(1, 2)
)
fec_tbl <- OpenPVA::validate_fecundity_table(fec_tbl)
fecundity_fun_custom <- OpenPVA::build_fecundity_fun_from_table(fec_tbl)

sc_repro_custom <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "custom_reproduction_demo",
  n_runs = 10,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(80),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = breeding_fun_custom,
  fecundity_fun = fecundity_fun_custom,
  K = 100,
  seed = 20260406L
)

out_repro <- OpenPVA::run_scenario(sc_repro_custom)
OpenPVA::summarise_extinction(out_repro$sim_output)
```

## Environmental variation and catastrophes on survival

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sc_no_cat <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "no_cat",
  n_runs = 15,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(80),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 100,
  lifecycle_steps = c("age", "survival"),
  env_surv_sd = 0,
  cat_surv_prob = 0,
  cat_surv_mult = 1,
  seed = 20260407L
)

sc_cat <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "cat",
  n_runs = 15,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(80),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 100,
  lifecycle_steps = c("age", "survival"),
  env_surv_sd = 0,
  cat_surv_prob = 0.2,
  cat_surv_mult = 0.3,
  seed = 20260408L
)

scenarios_env <- list(no_cat = sc_no_cat, cat = sc_cat)

comp_env <- OpenPVA::compare_scenarios(
  scenarios_env,
  extinction_threshold = 0
)
comp_env
```

## Rescue via supplementation

## Compare YAML schema v1 and v2 behaviour

```{r, eval=FALSE}
yaml_v1_path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "demo_demography.yaml",
  package = "OpenPVA"
)
if (yaml_v1_path == "") yaml_v1_path <- file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", "demo_demography.yaml")

yaml_v2_path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "demo_reproduction_v2.yaml",
  package = "OpenPVA"
)
if (yaml_v2_path == "") yaml_v2_path <- file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", "demo_reproduction_v2.yaml")

sc_v1 <- OpenPVA::read_scenario_yaml(yaml_v1_path)
sc_v2 <- OpenPVA::read_scenario_yaml(yaml_v2_path)

out_v1 <- OpenPVA::run_scenario(sc_v1)
out_v2 <- OpenPVA::run_scenario(sc_v2)

list(
  v1_schema = attr(sc_v1, "yaml_schema_version"),
  v2_schema = attr(sc_v2, "yaml_schema_version")
)

OpenPVA::summarise_extinction(out_v1$sim_output)
OpenPVA::summarise_extinction(out_v2$sim_output)

head(out_v1$sim_output$summary[, c("year", "n_births", "env_repro_p_mult", "repro_catastrophe")])
head(out_v2$sim_output$summary[, c("year", "n_births", "env_repro_p_mult", "repro_catastrophe")])
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
supp_steps <- c("age", "survival", "supplementation", "harvest")

sc_harvest_only <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "harvest_only",
  n_runs = 12,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(50),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 80,
  harvest_quota = 5,
  lifecycle_steps = supp_steps,
  seed = 20260409L
)

sc_harvest_plus_supp <- OpenPVA::scenario_spec(
  name = "harvest_plus_supp",
  n_runs = 12,
  n_years = 30,
  init_fun = function() OpenPVA::initialize_population(50),
  survival_fun = OpenPVA::default_survival_fun,
  breeding_fun = OpenPVA::default_breeding_fun,
  fecundity_fun = OpenPVA::default_fecundity_fun,
  K = 80,
  harvest_quota = 5,
  lifecycle_steps = supp_steps,
  supplement_quota = 2,
  supplement_patch = 1L,
  seed = 20260410L
)

rescue_comparison <- OpenPVA::compare_scenarios(
  list(harvest_only = sc_harvest_only, harvest_plus_supp = sc_harvest_plus_supp),
  extinction_threshold = 0
)
rescue_comparison
```
